query:
INSERT INTO moderators (external_id, auth_backend, display_name, last_login_at)
          VALUES ($1, 'oidc', $2, now())
          ON CONFLICT (auth_backend, external_id) DO UPDATE
            SET display_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.display_name, moderators.display_name),
                last_login_at = now()
          RETURNING id
